bundle.shortDescription: Local AI agent (JEV) and LeJEPA models on your own data
bundle.longDescription: JEV Studio runs JEV, a local AI agent that answers questions, writes and runs code in a sandbox, makes images and videos and simulates physics with models from your own Ollama, asking before anything leaves the sandbox. It also pretrains LeJEPA (JEPA + SIGReg) encoders on your own unlabeled data with a private PyTorch environment, shows what they learned, and plans with a learned world model.
